assessments.reasoning: The exact citation supports the ordinal index grammar and an index-to-component mapping at a single nesting level. The claim’s conditions also allow a multidimensional declaration and a single index from that declaration. Later text and Example 2 on this same page establish a nested array as the component selected by the first index in that case.

challenge.method: Read the full printed p.18, physical PDF p.24. Expand Example 2’s abbreviated Boolean, subrange, and size index list into its displayed nested form and check the type reached at the Boolean index.
challenge.results: In the abbreviated declaration the last type explicitly named is real. Applying the first index selects an array over the remaining index types. The broad exact claim consequently lacks support. A revision could explicitly limit its applicability to exactly one index type and retain the same pinpoint.

limitations: The mapping does not set a memory layout, lower bound of one for all arrays, or conformant-array handling. The same clause separately defines equivalent nesting for multiple index types and handles designated packing.
Exact unextended ISO/IEC 7185:1990 online replica. The replica gives the printed text precedence where they differ. ISO 10206 Extended Pascal and product dialects require separate evidence.
Do not promote the frozen revision. Its wording leaves the effective intermediate component type ambiguous for a declaration with several index types.
